read_scope: coordinator clarification of inherited sampler/DDIM and plugin normalization interfaces
context_exposure.details: Read all drawer bundle text, loaded both bundled trajectory NPZs through Pixi, viewed each of16 actual PNGs separately. No parent source, reward/expert source, other task records, larger D_N, old trained-model outcomes, or concrete development/test states. Proposal saved before implementation or shared-source inspection.

combination_consideration.adopted: P3 combines the P1 cabinet frame with learned future-relation denoising, extending P2 rail-only future supervision to contact gap as well. P1 isolates representation benefit and P2 isolates a world-action future-learning mechanism.
combination_consideration.rationale: D2 separates long approach from short rail motion; hand-handle gap may distinguish approach/contact while future rail distance describes progress. Use jointly generated targets so no hand-coded phase switch or analytic controller is introduced.
combination_consideration.rejected: No hard contact threshold selector or termination rule: two successful demonstrations do not support robust threshold decisions. No global rotation augmentation because fixed robot/gravity/obstacles invalidate whole-scene symmetry.
combination_consideration.uncertainty: The combination is a hypothesis, not an assumed improvement; auxiliary targets may compete with action loss.

candidates.applicability: State-input drawer task with declared yaw channel and a prismatic cabinet-local y rail. Shared numerical runtime observations only; images inform design but are never policy inputs.
candidates.augmentation: None. Rotating the cabinet is not a whole-environment symmetry because the robot, table, rail and gravity are fixed.

training_schedule.dataset: Each N in2/5/10/20 trains separately from scratch using only its nested D_N; no transfer. Uniform CPU torch.randint over all valid trajectory windows.
training_schedule.optimizer: One joint AdamW over entire policy, lr1e-4, weight_decay1e-6, betas[0.9,0.999], gradient_norm_clip1, EMA0.995, no warmup or staged fitting.
training_schedule.diffusion: DDPM100 cosine epsilon training; DDIM16 leading indices90,84,...,0 at deployment, eta0, clip_sample=False. Independent standard Gaussian noise in all generated channels.
training_schedule.loss_schedule: All specified losses active from update1 through20000; no selector, extra updates, or task-specific batch sampling.

candidates.hierarchy_selection_and_termination: One jointly trained conditional diffusion policy; no selector, phase label, route, analytic controller, success detector, termination gate, action search or rescue. Replan every4 executed actions under the unchanged episode clock; environment handles its existing termination.
candidates.chunk_transition_handling: One latest-observation R_t and origin o_t are held for both history observations and the complete16-step chunk, including any approach/pull transition. No re-encoding or frame change during execution of first4 actions; recompute frame only at next replan. World-action P2 keeps identity action frame. Zero-pad tail actions/labels beyond the last valid transition and mask them out of all losses.
candidates.required_runtime_inputs: Only two shared41-dimensional raw observations (initial repeated), including hand xyz/aperture, current/previous handle xyz, declared goal and yaw. No hidden state, future state, episode time feature, image, trained-model outcome, or expert action.
candidates.parameter_budget: One U-Net widths[64,128,256], time embedding128, kernel5, groups8. No extra trainable encoder or head. Only conditioning/input/output dimensions differ from B0; expected under5.5M and must be counted before training, hard limit3x exact B0 count.
candidates.confidence: Moderate geometry confidence from known prismatic rail and D2 agreement; low-to-moderate confidence of learned generalization benefit. No scores or additional demonstrations seen.

knowledge_hypotheses.claim: Rigid-coordinate changes express cabinet-parallel/perpendicular displacement without mixing x translation with yaw. A prismatic mechanism has one translational rail degree of freedom. This changes representation only; retaining world context avoids asserting whole-scene rotational symmetry.
knowledge_hypotheses.source_reference: Supplied task_materials.json source_knowledge (joint_type=prismatic, mechanism_axis=cabinet-local y), static_geometry_source hash2a2f29aa47ab399e16fe69c5428d2e14777842baf3e27b68a5b28884d1e14d59, and elementary rotation matrices; source implementation not opened.

knowledge_hypotheses.claim: Both demonstrations lift to ~0.302/0.305m at step25, descend before handle motion at transition69, then displace handle -0.134964/-0.130192m along local y; measured off-rail displacement below1e-8m. Initial goal-minus-handle is local y approximately-0.128m.
knowledge_hypotheses.source_reference: Both bundled NPZs, all transitions; all16 actual frames viewed.

knowledge_hypotheses.claim: Explicit cabinet-relative hand/goal relations and local actions should reduce sensitivity to correlated x/yaw training cells, while world context can preserve approach feasibility.

candidates.predicted_generalization_gain: Prospectively strongest benefit when cabinet x/yaw combinations change but local handle contact and pull geometry remain similar. It may offer no gain if the learned approach remains dependent on the two seen robot configurations.
failure_conditions: Local action coefficients can exceed1, so clipping before world decode would corrupt pulls.
Large yaw can alter contact feasibility with the fixed gripper; coordinate changes do not solve unreachable geometry.
Only two whole observations may not disambiguate similar approach and retreat states.

observation_transform.name: fixed-scale local relations with retained world context
observation_transform.definition: For latest raw observation x_t define normalized (s,c)=x_t[39:41]/norm, R_t=[[c,-s,0],[s,c,0],[0,0,1]], local ex=(c,s,0), ey=(-s,c,0) along cabinet prismatic rail, ez=(0,0,1) upward; origin o_t=x_t[4:7] is current yaw-corrected handle. Columns of R map local vectors into world; local vectors are R_t^T times world. Reject a nonfinite or norm<1e-6 yaw pair. All geometry lengths are meters.
observation_transform.history: Both whole observations in the shared two-observation history use this same latest t anchor; initial observation is repeated. For each history member x_j use its current h=x_j[0:3], d=x_j[4:7], goal g=x_j[36:39], previous hprev=x_j[18:21], dprev=x_j[22:25].
observation_transform.normalization: Exactly the listed fixed scales, all 25 output indices passthrough mean0/std1; no fitted observation statistics; no feature clipping. No object2 absent zeros or redundant quaternion retained.

action_transform.xyz: For all 16 future actions use a_local_xyz=R_t^T a_world_xyz with latest replan R_t fixed. Coefficients remain native action units, where 1 means commanded 0.01m before native dynamics. No translation is applied to displacement actions.
action_transform.gripper: Fourth coordinate unchanged and learned; do not force the observed -1 constant.
action_transform.decode: Take generated first4 channels, world_xyz=R_t a_local_xyz, keep gripper, THEN clip each world coordinate and gripper to [-1,1]. Never clip local action coordinates (observed local values exceed magnitude1).

losses_and_weights.name: action_epsilon
losses_and_weights.target: standard Gaussian epsilon added to4 encoded action channels
losses_and_weights.loss: masked mean squared error over valid transitions and4 action coordinates
losses_and_weights.condition: all valid sampled chunk positions at every update

candidates.required_train_labels: Only demonstrated actions, common observations and valid-action masks from current D_N; no derived future labels.
implementation_steps: Implement and roundtrip-test rotation with local magnitudes>1.
Implement common-anchor two-observation25-feature encoder with fixed scales.
Use shared4-channel U-Net, scheduler, masking and20k training; count parameters and record audit.

knowledge_hypotheses.claim: Jointly denoising a future rail-distance sequence with world actions may teach the shared network which action subsequences leave the drawer static and which produce task progress, without hard phase gates.

candidates.predicted_generalization_gain: May improve continuity and task progress on new factor combinations by sharing action and future-outcome modeling; less direct yaw transfer than P1. Auxiliary prediction may fail to benefit control.

architecture.core: shared conditional U-Net with joint action/future output

modules: 5-channel joint diffusion; only first4 channels executed

observation_transform.name: world observations plus explicit world relations
observation_transform.normalization: All output indices passthrough mean0/std1; world raw coordinates are meters, raw apertures unitless, quaternions and yaw unitless. No fitted statistics or feature clipping. Standard shared history of two whole observations.

action_transform.xyz: First3 channels are unchanged world action coefficients; one unit commands native0.01m.
action_transform.gripper: Fourth channel unchanged and learned; no constant command override.
action_transform.decode: Take generated first4 channels and clip world xyz and gripper to native[-1,1].

losses_and_weights.name: action_epsilon
losses_and_weights.target: standard Gaussian epsilon added to first4 world action channels
losses_and_weights.loss: masked mean squared error over valid transitions and4 action coordinates
losses_and_weights.condition: all valid sampled chunk positions at every update

losses_and_weights.name: future_rail_epsilon
losses_and_weights.target: epsilon added to label y_k = ey_t dot (goal_t - handle_(t+k+1)) /0.16 for k=0..15; signed value, no clipping; future observations from same D_N episode only
losses_and_weights.loss: masked mean squared error over the fifth generated channel
losses_and_weights.condition: all valid action positions; do not train masked terminal padding

candidates.required_train_labels: For each window start t and valid action k, next observed handle position at t+k+1. Project current goal minus this future handle onto normalized current cabinet ey and divide by0.16m. No reward, success, phase, action-derived target or data outside current D_N.
implementation_steps: Build aligned one-step-through16-step future rail labels with valid mask.
Append rail labels to clean training actions and enlarge diffusion channels to5.
Apply action epsilon mean first4 plus0.25 rail epsilon; sample5 channels and discard last at execution; count parameters.
